services.title: Property Preservation
services.shortDescription: Preserve, secure, and maintain vacant, foreclosed, or distressed properties with compliance photo reporting.
services.fullDescription: We help preserve, secure, and maintain vacant or distressed properties. Services include initial inspections, lock changes, lockbox support, boarding coordination, lawn maintenance, debris removal, winterization/de-winterization, and comprehensive condition reporting.

services.title: Listing Prep & Inspection Repairs
services.shortDescription: Full punch-list repairs, cosmetic fixes, and contractor coordination before listing or closing.
services.fullDescription: We help Realtors reduce the stress of managing contractors before listing, closing, inspection response, or repair deadlines. Support includes punch-list repairs, handyman coordination, curb appeal work, clean-outs, lock changes, exterior cleanup, and fast estimates.
features: Quick Repair Estimates for Closing Credits

services.title: Tenant Turnover & Make-Ready
services.shortDescription: Rapid unit turnaround, repair punch lists, deep cleaning, and make-ready services for rental portfolios.
services.fullDescription: We support property managers with turns, make-ready services, vendor follow-up, photo documentation, and work order processing. Minimize vacancy days with synchronized trade scheduling.

services.title: Trash-Out & Debris Removal
services.shortDescription: Interior and exterior cleanouts, bulk item hauling, shed removal, and broom-sweep sanitization.
services.fullDescription: Fast debris and trash removal for foreclosures, tenant evictions, hoarding conditions, and abandoned properties. Complete hauling, disposal compliance, and hazardous material flagging.

services.title: Roofing Inspections & Repairs
services.shortDescription: Tarping, emergency leak patching, shingle replacement, flashing repair, and roof condition documentation.
services.fullDescription: Protect the asset envelope from water intrusion. We coordinate licensed roofing contractors for emergency tarping, missing shingle repairs, gutter apron fixes, and drone/ladder roof inspections.

services.title: Landscaping & Lawn Maintenance
services.shortDescription: Regular grass cuts, weed trimming, hedge pruning, lot clearing, and HOA violation abatement.
services.fullDescription: Keep properties compliant with city codes, HOA regulations, and market presentation standards. Initial cut, bi-weekly recurring lawn maintenance, shrub pruning, and tree limb trimming away from roofs.

services.title: Power Washing Services
services.shortDescription: High-pressure cleaning for driveways, sidewalks, siding, decks, and stucco to restore curb appeal.
services.fullDescription: Remove dirt, algae, mold, and oil stains from exterior building surfaces, concrete driveways, walkways, fences, and patios. Essential for listing preparation and rental showings.

services.title: Interior Carpentry & Handyman
services.shortDescription: Repairing doors, windows, cabinets, baseboards, trim, shelving, and general structural cosmetic fixes.
services.fullDescription: Skilled carpentry coordination for doors that stick, damaged subfloors, broken kitchen cabinets, closet rods, molding, stair railings, and general handyman punch-list items.

services.title: Flooring Repairs & Installation
services.shortDescription: LVP, laminate, carpet replacement, subfloor patch repair, and transition strips.
services.fullDescription: Modernize tired floors or repair pet-damaged, water-damaged surfaces. We coordinate durable luxury vinyl plank (LVP), laminate, tile repairs, and carpet stretch/replacement.

services.title: Gutter Cleaning & Maintenance
services.shortDescription: Clearing debris, re-attaching loose gutters, downspout flushing, and gutter guard installation.
services.fullDescription: Prevent water foundation damage and roof overflow. Comprehensive gutter cleaning, debris bagging, downspout snaking, and seam re-caulking.

services.title: Electrical Service Coordination
services.shortDescription: Coordinating licensed electricians for panel inspections, GFCI upgrades, light fixtures, and smoke detectors.
services.fullDescription: Ensure safety code compliance for home inspections and tenant move-ins. Coordinated with verified, licensed electrical subcontractors in your jurisdiction.
features: GFCI Outlet Installation in Wet Areas

services.title: Appliance Maintenance & Installs
services.shortDescription: Diagnostic coordination, refrigerator, stove, dishwasher, microwave repairs, hookups, and haul-away.
services.fullDescription: Fast diagnostic and replacement coordination for essential household appliances. We handle delivery coordination, basic installations, testing, and old unit disposal.
features: Dishwasher Leak Check & Water Line Connect

googleReviews.author: Sarah Jenkins
googleReviews.text: EZY Zenith is my secret weapon for listing deadlines! When my client received a 14-item inspection repair amendment just 6 days before closing, EZY Zenith handled the entire punch-list, provided before/after photos for the buyer's agent, and saved our deal. Invaluable partner!

googleReviews.author: Marcus Sterling
googleReviews.role: Senior Asset Manager, Vanguard Capital REO
googleReviews.text: Managing over 80 foreclosed assets across multiple counties requires speed, clear photos, and zero excuses. EZY Zenith secures properties within 24 hours, takes meticulous photo documentation, and their winterizations are flawless. Best coordination service in the U.S.

googleReviews.author: Elena Rodriguez
googleReviews.role: Director of Property Management, Coastal Living Rentals
googleReviews.text: Turnover season used to be a nightmare of calling 10 different contractors who never showed up. With EZY Zenith, I submit one work order and they coordinate drywall, painting, deep cleaning, and rekeying. Our average turnover downtime dropped from 14 days to 4 days.

googleReviews.author: David Chen
googleReviews.text: I bought a distressed 3-bedroom property with hoarding conditions. EZY Zenith did the full trash-out in 48 hours, landscaped the overgrown yard, and pressure washed the driveway. Professional, honest pricing, and constant updates.

googleReviews.author: Rachel Vance
googleReviews.text: Their communication is outstanding. In this business, knowing when a contractor is on-site and seeing immediate proof of work via time-stamped photos is everything. EZY Zenith sets the gold standard for property service coordination.

faqs.question: Do you work with Realtors and listing agents?
faqs.answer: Yes, absolutely! Realtor listing preparation, inspection repair list resolution, and closing support are core specialties. We handle buyer repair amendments, punch-lists, and cosmetic fixes on tight deadlines with full photo documentation.

faqs.question: Do you provide before and after photos?
faqs.answer: Yes. Every single work order includes date-and-time stamped before, during, and after photos uploaded directly to your completion report for escrow verification, asset manager compliance, or security deposit deductions.

faqs.question: How are licensed trades handled (roofing, electrical, plumbing)?
faqs.answer: EZY Zenith coordinates field services through qualified vendors and subcontractors. Any licensed trade work (electrical, HVAC, plumbing, structural roofing) is strictly performed by verified, qualified, licensed, and insured subcontractors where required by local and state law.

faqs.question: Can you support emergency or urgent property requests?
faqs.answer: Yes. We offer rapid dispatch for securing vacant properties, emergency boarding, water shutoff, freeze prevention/winterization, and urgent 24-48 hour repair requests depending on vendor access and property location.

faqs.question: How do vendors and contractors join your network?
faqs.answer: Qualified contractors can apply directly through our 'Become a Vendor' portal. Requirements include a valid W-9, General Liability & Workers' Compensation insurance, references, and demonstrated reliability in your local market.
